definition.history_choice: index1 if valid, else index0 if valid, else unavailable
definition.cv: (global_center_t0-global_center_past)/(timestamp_t0-timestamp_past), rotated by t0 LiDAR R inverse; no future sample in velocity
definition.zero_motion: zero displacement in fixed t0 LiDAR R, not zero relative-to-moving-ego displacement
definition.primary_speed: per horizon: norm(global_center_h_xy-global_center_t0_xy)/actual_dt_h; endpoint average speed magnitude, not accumulated-path speed
definition.distance: t0 fixed LiDAR xy Euclidean norm, meters; [0,10),[10,30),[30,50),[50,infinity)
definition.visibility: raw t0 annotation visibility token; no visibility filtering
definition.ROI: t0 center in half-open original box [-51.2,51.2)x[-51.2,51.2)x[-5,3); center test only, not fine occupancy coverage
definition.paired: Both baseline errors use same t0-present, future-present, past-present instance/horizon set
definition.zero_all_available: Additional zero baseline uses every t0/future valid pair; do not compare to CV with different denominator
definition.delta: zero error minus CV error: positive favors CV
definition.pooling: Each eligible anchor-instance-horizon equally weighted; instance sizes/voxel counts not weighted
definition.quantiles: NumPy linear percentiles; p90 is a descriptive quantile, not a confidence bound
